requirements.requirement: The system must extract credential and taxonomy fields from NPI provider data returned by provider_detail_service.py.
The system must identify board certifications by parsing credential strings for known certification patterns (e.g., 'MD', 'DO', 'Board Certified', specialty board names).
The system must normalize extracted certification text into a standardized format for comparison.
The system must extract provider taxonomy codes and associated specialty descriptions from NPI data.
The system must accept a queried specialty as input for relevance scoring.
The system must compute a relevance score by matching extracted board certifications against the queried specialty using taxonomy alignment.
The system must compute a relevance score using keyword matching when taxonomy alignment is not available.
The system must assign a higher relevance score when certification specialty directly matches the queried specialty.
The system must assign a lower but non-zero relevance score when certification partially matches or is related to the queried specialty.
The system must assign a zero relevance score when no certifications match or relate to the queried specialty.
The system must return an empty certification list and a zero score when no credential data is present in the NPI response.
The system must handle malformed or unparseable credential strings without failing and default to zero relevance score.
The system must ensure scoring logic executes deterministically for the same input data.
The system must complete extraction and scoring within acceptable backend response time thresholds defined by existing provider_detail_service patterns.
